services.intro: Choose a practice area to learn more, or request a consultation directly.

family.title: Family law
family.summary: Marriage, divorce, custody, alimony and inheritance matters.
family.body: Family disputes are personal and often urgent. The firm advises on marriage contracts, divorce and khula, custody and visitation, alimony, and the division of inheritance, and represents clients before the personal status courts.

faq.q: Can you help with custody arrangements?
faq.a: Yes. The firm advises on custody and visitation and can represent you in court.
Yes, including disputes between heirs and the procedures for dividing an estate.

faq.q: What should I bring to the first consultation?
faq.a: Any documents related to your case, such as the marriage contract, court orders or correspondence.

labor.title: Labour law
labor.summary: Wrongful dismissal, end-of-service benefits, unpaid wages and employment contracts.
labor.body: The firm helps employees and employers with employment contracts, wrongful dismissal claims, end-of-service benefits, unpaid wages, and cases before the labour courts and the amicable settlement stage.

faq.q: I was dismissed. Can I claim compensation?
faq.a: It depends on your contract and the reason for dismissal. A lawyer will review your situation and explain your options.
Yes. The firm advises employers on contracts, policies and disputes.
Your employment contract, salary records, and any letters or messages from your employer.

commercial.title: Commercial law
commercial.summary: Company formation, contracts, partnership disputes and debt collection.
commercial.body: The firm advises businesses on company formation, drafting and reviewing contracts, partnership disputes, debt collection, and cases before the commercial courts.

faq.q: Can you review a contract before I sign it?
faq.a: Yes. Contract review and drafting is a core part of the firm's commercial work.

faq.q: Do you handle disputes between partners?
faq.a: Yes, including negotiation and litigation before the commercial courts.

faq.q: Can you help collect unpaid invoices?
faq.a: Yes. A lawyer will review the documents and advise on the best route to recover the debt.

criminal.title: Criminal law
criminal.summary: Defence in criminal cases, investigations and appeals.
criminal.body: The firm represents clients during investigation and trial, prepares defence memoranda, and handles appeals. Early legal advice can make an important difference.

faq.q: Can a lawyer attend the investigation with me?
faq.a: A lawyer can advise you on your rights and, where permitted, attend with you.
Yes. The firm prepares appeals against criminal judgments.
Yes. Everything you share with the firm is kept confidential.

real_estate.title: Real estate law
real_estate.summary: Property disputes, sale contracts, leases and title deeds.
real_estate.body: The firm advises on property sale and purchase contracts, leases, disputes between owners and tenants, title deed issues, and real estate development agreements.

faq.q: Can you help with a tenant who will not pay?
faq.a: Yes. The firm advises landlords on eviction and rent recovery procedures.

faq.q: Do you review property sale contracts?
faq.a: Yes, before signing and when disputes arise.

faq.q: Can you help with title deed problems?
faq.a: Yes. A lawyer will review the deed and advise on the correct procedure.

privacy.metaTitle: Privacy policy | [CLIENT TO PROVIDE: firm name]
privacy.metaDescription: How the firm collects, uses and protects your personal data.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.draftNotice: Draft for the firm's legal review before launch.

sections.title: Data we collect
body: When you request a consultation we collect your name, phone number, email (optional), case type and your message.
We also record how you reached the site (for example the advertising campaign or referring page) and your device type.

sections.title: Why we use it
body: To contact you about your request and provide legal services.
To measure which advertising brings genuine requests, only where you have agreed to cookies.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: Requests are kept for up to 24 months, after which personal details are deleted or anonymised, unless the law requires longer.

sections.title: Who we share it with
body: Only service providers that host and run the site and our communications, under confidentiality obligations. We do not sell your data.

sections.title: Your rights
body: Under the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law you can ask to access, correct or delete your data. Contact us at [CLIENT TO PROVIDE: privacy contact email].
